The report, citing a person familiar with the deal, said FieldAI has added at least $35 million in revenue and customer contracts since June, bringing the total to more than $135 million.

The valuation is a bet that FieldAI can make its robot brain work in unpredictable real-world settings, according to the Business Insider report. That is much more difficult than training a machine for a single task in a controlled environment, and it is a challenge that has long tripped up robotics companies.
